title: DriveWLA: Unifying Future Dynamics and Scene Semantics through World-Language-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2610.17903v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and world models have demonstrated strong capabilities in semantic understanding and future scene evolution for autonomous driving. However, effectively integrating both capabilities for trajectory generation remains challenging. In this work, we propose DriveWLA, a unified World-Language-Action model based on Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) that jointly models semantic understanding, future scene dynamics, and trajectory generation. DriveWLA consists of three experts: a World Expert for future prediction, a Language Expert for semantic understanding, and an Action Expert for trajectory generation. We further introduce Cross-Expert Attention, which enables controlled information flow across experts while aligning semantic and dynamic representations. translated_title: DriveWLA：通过世界-语言-动作建模统一未来动态与场景语义的自动驾驶方法
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）和世界模型已经在自动驾驶的语义理解和未来场景演化方面展现出强大的能力。然而，如何有效整合这两种能力以实现轨迹生成仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了DriveWLA，一个基于混合Transformer（Mixture-of-Transformers, MoT）的统一世界-语言-动作模型，它联合建模语义理解、未来场景动态和轨迹生成。DriveWLA由三个专家模块组成：用于未来预测的世界专家、用于语义理解的语言专家以及用于轨迹生成的动作专家。我们进一步引入了跨专家注意力机制，在实现专家间受控信息流动的同时，对齐语义与动态表示。为了使轨迹生成超越模仿学习的限制，我们应用Flow-GRPO强化学习后训练来优化动作专家。大量的实验证明
tldr: 提出DriveWLA，一个基于混合Transformer的统一世界-语言-动作模型，通过世界、语言、动作三个专家模块联合建模语义理解、未来场景动态与轨迹生成，并结合跨专家注意力机制和Flow-GRPO强化学习后训练提升自动驾驶轨迹规划性能。
en_tdlr: DriveWLA is a unified World-Language-Action model based on Mixture-of-Transformers that jointly models semantic understanding, future scene dynamics, and trajectory generation for autonomous driving, enhanced by Cross-Expert Attention and Flow-GRPO reinforcement learning post-training.
